title: I need to bring it positive. One of my best teaching experience was doing PhD in East Hartford after Obama was elected. Students electrified all year.
summary: I need to bring it positive. One of my best teaching experience was doing PhD in East Hartford after Obama was elected. Students electrified all year. "Hey Mister did you know I can be president?" Sweetest words I ever heard.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I need to bring it positive. One of my best teaching experience was doing PhD in East Hartford after Obama was elected.

Students electrified all year.

"Hey Mister did you know I can be president?" Sweetest words I ever heard.
